Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, street-facing, fov 76
- residential road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks present, curbs present
- driveways: corner entrance apron; parking: concrete apron in front of the bays
- small office with plate glass building at corner of the lot, 1 story, brick veneer, plate glass, flat parapet roof, 20 feet from road setback
- service bay row under one continuous roof building at rear of the lot, 1 story, concrete block, corrugated metal, flat roof, 40 feet from road setback
- utilities: overhead power lines, utility pole at the corner
- landscape: narrow grass strip along the road, gravel edge along the apron
- immutable elements: painted sign band across the parapet, corner lot at the intersection, concrete apron in front of the service bays
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1985
Reagan era prosperity. A neighborhood auto repair shop in 1985 — backlit sign letters over the bays, radial tires stacked out front, and a shop moving from carburetors to the first electronic engine diagnostics.

PERIOD DETAILS
- a faded price board from a previous era, papered over with a new one reading 'BRAKES $59.95'
- a stack of radial tires displayed just outside the office door
- office with plate glass window, a hand-lettered 'BRAKES • MUFFLERS' sign taped inside
- window signs: 'OIL CHANGE $12.95', 'MUFFLERS INSTALLED TODAY'
- a bell hose stretched across the apron
- a faded painted sign ghosted beneath the newer backlit letters
Typography: bold geometric sans-serif, early computer-influenced fonts.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 6 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 2 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a mechanic testing a muffler clamp under a raised car
- a woman in a business suit dropping off a company car
- a jogger in a tracksuit and headband
Clothing: men in windbreakers, acid wash jeans; women in big permed hair, shoulder pads. Fashion palette: neon pink, electric blue, purple. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 5 period vehicles, all different:
- 1980-1985 Buick LeSabre — boxy full-size, chrome trim — silver
- 1983-1985 Nissan Maxima — boxy import sedan — red
- 1984-1988 Pontiac Fiero — small wedge two-seater — white
- 1984-1989 Plymouth Voyager — boxy first-generation minivan — burgundy
- 1982-1993 Chevrolet S-10 — compact pickup, square — light blue
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1985.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: three parked on the RIGHT side; the rest parked on the LEFT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, painted crosswalks
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, wooden utility poles

TREES
- maple tree at street corner: clearly smaller than in the source — about 35% of its canopy there, thinner trunk
- elm tree at side yard: a young tree, only about 15% of its canopy in the source photo, thin trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — Kodacolor VR 200 or Fujicolor 100 look.
Color: slightly cool tones compared to 1970s. Grain: moderate grain, cleaner than 1975.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 1980-1985 Buick LeSabre — boxy full-size, chrome trim
